font_repairs.source: Installed PyMuPDF/MuPDF built-in URW Nimbus CFF font program
font_repairs.verification: This is a documented compatible substitute, not the recovered original font. Existing PDF widths/encoding and existing ToUnicode retained; missing Base14 widths/Unicode supplied from the matching glyph names. Glyph advance corrections preserve source positioning and leave outlines/hints unchanged. Validate every page at144DPI and compare text.
